name: Honkai: Star Rail
tagline: Working Honkai: Star Rail codes for free Stellar Jade, Credits and upgrade materials.
description: Honkai: Star Rail is HoYoverse's turn-based space-fantasy RPG. The team releases redemption codes during every version livestream (twice per major patch), and ad-hoc codes for milestones and promotional events. Livestream codes are short-lived, often expiring within a day or two, so it's worth redeeming the moment they go live. STARRAILGIFT is a long-running permanent code for new and returning players.
longDescription:
Honkai: Star Rail is HoYoverse's turn-based space-fantasy RPG, launched in April 2023 as the studio's follow-up to Genshin Impact. Unlike Genshin's open-world action combat, Star Rail uses a classical turn-based JRPG combat system with a unique Speed-based turn order, a Weakness-Break mechanic that interrupts enemy actions, and a 'Path' character classification that maps loosely onto traditional roles (DPS, Healer, Support).

For most players the bottleneck resource is **Stellar Jade** — the soft gacha currency, equivalent to Genshin's Primogems. A ten-pull on either the Character or Light Cone banner costs 1,600 Stellar Jade, and a hard-pity Five-Star character requires roughly 14,000 Stellar Jade end-to-end. Codes are the cheapest free source of Stellar Jade in the game.

Star Rail's code system runs on a faster cadence than Genshin's. Each version (six-week cycles) ships two preview livestreams — phase one before the version launches, phase two halfway through — and each broadcast drops three redemption codes worth 100 Stellar Jade each. Phase one codes typically expire within 48 hours; phase two codes can last several days. Permanent codes like `STARRAILGIFT` are added rarely but stay active indefinitely. The development team also drops single-reward 'compensation' codes after server maintenance or content patches that needed hotfixing — these are often the easiest source of free Stellar Jade outside the livestream cycle.
videoTitle: How to redeem Honkai: Star Rail codes — mobile and PC full guide
whatCodesDo:
Honkai: Star Rail codes drop one of four reward types, each tied to a specific progression bottleneck. **Stellar Jade** is the headline reward and the soft gacha currency — each livestream code drops 50 to 100 Stellar Jade, and a full livestream sweep can land 300 Stellar Jade in your inbox, roughly 2% of a hard-pity Five-Star. Stellar Jade carries over indefinitely, so the optimal strategy is to bank code Jade toward whichever Character or Light Cone banner is closest to your pity timer.

**Credits** are the gold-equivalent currency, used for character level-ups, trace unlocks, and Light Cone superimposition. Codes typically drop 10,000 to 50,000 Credits, a small contribution against a Five-Star trace grind that needs around 1.4M Credits end-to-end. **Traveler's Guides** are blue books that grant 5,000 character XP each; codes usually drop two to five at a time, useful for newer accounts levelling fresh characters.

**Fuel** is the rarest code reward — each one converts to 60 Trailblaze Power (the daily stamina). Codes occasionally drop 1 to 2 Fuel; bank them for high-yield farming days (Relic Cavern or Echo of War events). Finally, **Condensed Aether** and **Refined Aether** are mid-tier farming currencies used to skip Calyx farming runs once a day — they appear in promotional bundle codes (`4TKSX77Y58QK`, for example) and are most valuable when you are pushing a new character through their ascension materials.
whereToFindMore: New Honkai: Star Rail codes are announced during the official HoYoverse [version preview livestreams](https://www.hoyolab.com/circles/6) on the HoYoverse YouTube channel — held the weekend before each version launches, with a second 'phase 2' livestream roughly three weeks into the cycle. The redemption codes are revealed in three timed bursts during the broadcast; mirror posts go up on the [official Twitter / X account](https://twitter.com/honkaistarrail), the [Star Rail subreddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/HonkaiStarRail/), and the HoYoLab community app within minutes. Maintenance compensation and event codes are posted directly to the Twitter / X account and to in-game mail. We refresh this page within an hour of any livestream end; bookmark the [latest codes view](/honkai-star-rail/latest) for the cleanest list.
releaseCadence: Honkai: Star Rail runs the most generous code calendar of any current HoYoverse title. **Six livestream codes per version** — three each from the phase-one (pre-launch) and phase-two (mid-cycle) preview broadcasts, worth roughly 300 Stellar Jade per livestream. Phase-one codes typically expire within 48 hours; phase-two codes can last three to five days. **Permanent codes** like `STARRAILGIFT` are added once or twice per year. **Compensation codes** are issued after any unscheduled maintenance or content hotfix — these are usually the easiest free Stellar Jade outside the livestream cycle, and they tend to last a full week. **Anniversary and milestone codes** drop separately from the version cycle — the 3rd anniversary code in April 2026 paid out 100 Stellar Jade. Expect the next batch alongside the next phase-one livestream — check the official Twitter / X account for the exact date.
expiredCodesContext: Honkai: Star Rail's livestream code window is short — phase-one codes typically expire within 48 hours of being announced, phase-two codes within three to five days. The codes archived below all paid out during the past six months; most were livestream codes from earlier version broadcasts (4.3, 3.1, 5.5) that wound down within days of the broadcast end. We keep the archive live so returning players can quickly confirm a code they saw in a YouTube thumbnail or Discord screenshot is genuinely dead, and so the dates document HoYoverse's livestream calendar at a glance.

redeemSteps.title: Reach Trailblaze Level 10
redeemSteps.detail: Your account must be at least Trailblaze Level 10 (TL 10) before the redemption portal will accept any code. New trailblazers will hit TL 10 within an hour of starting the game — complete the opening Herta Space Station arc as part of the main campaign. The redemption endpoint silently rejects sub-TL 10 accounts: there is no error message, the code simply refuses to apply.

redeemSteps.title: Open the redemption portal
redeemSteps.detail: Go to the official HoYoverse redemption page at [hsr.hoyoverse.com/gift](https://hsr.hoyoverse.com/gift). On mobile only, you can also redeem in-game via Phone menu → Profile → Redemption Code, which deep-links to the same portal. The PC and PlayStation builds do not have an in-game redemption button — the web portal is the only option.

redeemSteps.title: Log in and select your server
redeemSteps.detail: Sign in with the HoYoverse account that owns your Star Rail profile, then pick the correct server from the dropdown: America, Europe, Asia, or TW/HK/MO. Each server is a separate gacha pool and a separate redemption registry — redeeming on the wrong server consumes the code without paying rewards to your active character. Each HoYoverse account can have characters on multiple servers, so be careful to pick the right one.

redeemSteps.title: Paste the code and submit
redeemSteps.detail: Copy a code from this page using the Copy button next to it. Paste it character-for-character into the code input box on the portal. Star Rail codes are case-sensitive and almost always uppercase — `OMEGA` and `omega` are not the same. Hit the Redeem button and confirm on the modal that appears.

redeemSteps.title: Claim rewards from in-game mail
redeemSteps.detail: Stellar Jade, Credits, and materials arrive via in-game mail within a few minutes of a successful redemption. Open the Phone menu, tap Mail, and claim the rewards from the entry labelled 'Redemption Code'. Mail is held for 30 days before being purged, so claim it within the window even if you are not pulling immediately.

troubleshooting.cause: The code has expired (most likely for any livestream code redeemed more than 48 hours after announcement), or you typed it in the wrong case. Star Rail codes are case-sensitive.
troubleshooting.fix: Cross-check against our [Expired Codes archive](/honkai-star-rail/expired). If it is not there, copy-paste it directly from our Active table rather than retyping.

troubleshooting.symptom: Red error: 'Code has already been used'
troubleshooting.cause: Each code is one-time per HoYoverse account per server. You cannot redeem the same code twice on the same server.
troubleshooting.fix: If you have characters on multiple servers, the same code can be redeemed once per server — switch the server dropdown on the portal.

troubleshooting.symptom: Code accepted but no rewards in mail
troubleshooting.cause: Rewards can take up to five minutes to arrive in the in-game mailbox, and mail is held for 30 days before being purged.
troubleshooting.fix: Wait five minutes, then open the Phone menu → Mail. If still missing after 30 minutes, the most common cause is that you redeemed on the wrong server. Re-check the server you selected on the portal against the server your active character lives on.

troubleshooting.symptom: Portal says 'Account does not meet redemption requirements'
troubleshooting.cause: Your account is below Trailblaze Level 10.
troubleshooting.fix: Keep playing the opening Herta Space Station arc — most players hit TL 10 within the first hour. Codes redeemed before TL 10 are simply rejected; none are consumed.

troubleshooting.symptom: I want to redeem on a friend's account
troubleshooting.cause: Each redemption requires the HoYoverse account login.
troubleshooting.fix: Never share your HoYoverse credentials. Send the code itself to your friend — codes are universal and not account-bound until redeemed on a specific account / server combination.

faq.question: How often do new Honkai: Star Rail codes drop?
faq.answer: Six livestream codes per version cycle — three each from the phase-one (pre-launch) and phase-two (mid-cycle) preview broadcasts, worth roughly 300 Stellar Jade per livestream. Phase-one codes expire within 48 hours; phase-two codes last three to five days. Compensation codes (for unscheduled maintenance or hotfixes) and anniversary codes drop separately from the version cycle. Expect the next batch alongside the next phase-one livestream.

faq.question: Why is my Honkai: Star Rail code invalid?
faq.answer: The four common causes: the code expired (most likely for any livestream code more than 48 hours old), you typed it in the wrong case (codes are case-sensitive, almost always uppercase), you redeemed on the wrong server (each server is a separate registry), or your account is below Trailblaze Level 10.

faq.question: Can I redeem codes on multiple HoYoverse accounts?
faq.answer: Yes — any HoYoverse account can redeem a given code once per server. The same code cannot be redeemed twice on the same account / server combination, but if you have characters on multiple servers or multiple HoYoverse accounts, each is a separate registry.

faq.question: Where do my rewards go after redeeming?
faq.answer: Stellar Jade, Credits, Traveler's Guides, and other rewards arrive via in-game mail within five minutes of a successful redemption. Open the Phone menu → Mail and claim the rewards from the entry labelled 'Redemption Code'. Mail is held for 30 days; after that it is purged and cannot be recovered.

faq.question: When should I save Stellar Jade from codes?
faq.answer: Stellar Jade carries over indefinitely with no expiry, so the optimal strategy is to bank code Jade toward whichever Character or Light Cone banner is closest to your current pity timer or features the character you actually want. A guaranteed Five-Star costs around 14,000 Stellar Jade at hard pity; a full livestream sweep (300 Jade) covers about 2% of that — small but free.

faq.question: Are there any 'secret' Star Rail codes not on this list?
faq.answer: No. Every redemption code is announced through the official HoYoverse channels — livestream, Twitter / X, HoYoLab, in-game mail — before it goes live. If a YouTube thumbnail promises a 'secret' or 'leaked' code, it is almost always either a known code rebranded or a clickbait link to a phishing site. Never enter your HoYoverse credentials anywhere other than `hoyoverse.com` domains.

faq.question: Do codes work for Genshin Impact or Zenless Zone Zero?
faq.answer: No. Each HoYoverse game has its own redemption portal and its own codes. The Genshin redemption portal is at [genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/gift](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/gift) — we maintain a separate codes page for that game.

faq.question: Can I get banned for using codes?
faq.answer: No. Codes are an official feature of the redemption portal, operated directly by HoYoverse. The only relevant rule is that you must not share your HoYoverse credentials with anyone to redeem on your behalf — that violates the HoYoverse Terms of Service, regardless of whether codes are involved.
